授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）:
ＪＩＳの製図規格を基にした機械製図についてテキスト及び実習を通じて学ぶ．製図の基礎である文字や線の描き方，ねじやカップリングなどの機械要素の作図法などを学習し，また実際に手書きによる製図を行う．最終的には複雑な図面を読み取り，部品図・組立図を写すことで機械製図への理解を深める．
Learn about mechanical drawing based on JIS drafting standards through textbooks and practical training.The course covers the basics of drafting, such as how to draw letters and lines, and how to draw machine elements such as screws and couplings, as well as actual hand-drawn drawings.Finally, students deepen their understanding of mechanical drawing by reading complex drawings and copying parts and assembly drawings.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: The aims of this course are acquisition of basic drafting according to standard (JIS) and learning drafting techniques by drawing practice.
